questions.text: What is the source-safe purpose of grounding in lightning and surge conditions?

options.text: To limit voltage imposed by lightning, line surges, or accidental higher-voltage contact.
To make earth the only fault-current path.
To eliminate all need for bonding.
To replace communication protectors.

questions.rationale: To limit voltage imposed by lightning, line surges, or accidental higher-voltage contact. This answer matches PEC refined markdown lines 4483-4495.
questions.code_citation: PEC Part 2, NFPA 780, Maintenance and Testing section, tropical corrosion factors

questions.text: Why is bonding important in lightning-related electrical protection?

options.text: It intentionally isolates every electrode.
It helps create a low-impedance path and limits potential differences between systems.
It replaces all overcurrent devices.
It is only decorative metalwork.

questions.rationale: It helps create a low-impedance path and limits potential differences between systems. This answer matches PEC refined markdown lines 4495-4578.

questions.text: What separation does PEC require where practicable between communications wiring and lightning conductors?

options.text: At least 150 mm.
No separation when both are outdoors.
At least 1,800 mm.
Exactly the same support points.

questions.rationale: At least 1,800 mm. This answer matches PEC refined markdown lines 32160-32169.

questions.text: What protection is required for communications circuits exposed to lightning?

options.text: No protector if the cable is low voltage.
Only a larger wall outlet.
Only a decorative equipment cabinet.
Listed primary protectors at exposed building circuits as required by PEC.

questions.rationale: Listed primary protectors at exposed building circuits as required by PEC. This answer matches PEC refined markdown lines 32169-32176.

options.text: Bond them together with the required bonding jumper.
Keep them isolated to increase resistance.
Use hot water pipes as protector electrodes.
Ground only the television outlet faceplate.

questions.rationale: Bond them together with the required bonding jumper. This answer matches PEC refined markdown lines 32838-32920.
